name: component-hunt
description: Probe one fingerprinted host (or a named set) for the KNOWN misconfigurations and exposure behaviors of its specific framework — actuator endpoints on Spring Boot, wp-json/debug.log on WordPress, exposed configs per stack — using the ## Checks catalog of its tech playbook. Use for "hunt spring boot on app.acme.com", "check this wordpress host for known misconfigs", "run the laravel checks", "component hunt", or any ask naming a stack plus active testing.
